questions.interpretation: What is the overall on-time delivery rate?
questions.sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND NOT is_late) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered), 0) AS on_time_delivery_rate
FROM orders_enriched
LIMIT 100

questions.interpretation: Count of delivered orders that arrived late in 2017
questions.sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND is_late) AS late_order_count
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE purchase_quarter IN (?, ?, ?, ?)
LIMIT 100

questions.interpretation: What was the late delivery rate in RJ in 2018-Q1?
questions.sql:
SELECT customer_state AS state,
       purchase_quarter AS quarter,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND is_late) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered), 0) AS late_delivery_rate
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE customer_state = ?
  AND purchase_quarter = ?
GROUP BY customer_state, purchase_quarter
ORDER BY purchase_quarter
LIMIT 100

questions.interpretation: Which 3 states had the most late orders in 2018?
questions.sql:
SELECT customer_state AS state,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND is_late) AS late_order_count
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN ? AND ?
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY late_order_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3

questions.interpretation: On-time delivery rate by month from January to August 2018
questions.sql:
SELECT purchase_month AS month,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND NOT is_late) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered), 0) AS on_time_delivery_rate
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE purchase_month BETWEEN ? AND ?
GROUP BY purchase_month
ORDER BY purchase_month
LIMIT 100

questions.interpretation: Average delivery delay in days for São Paulo state per quarter in 2017
questions.sql:
SELECT purchase_quarter AS quarter,
       avg(delivery_delay_days) AS avg_delay_days
FROM order_delivery
WHERE customer_state = ?
  AND purchase_quarter IN (?, ?, ?, ?)
GROUP BY purchase_quarter
ORDER BY purchase_quarter
LIMIT 100

questions.interpretation: Which 5 product categories had the highest revenue in 2017?
questions.sql:
SELECT category AS category,
       sum(line_revenue) FILTER (WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) AS revenue
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE purchase_quarter IN (?, ?, ?, ?)
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

questions.interpretation: On average, how many days did delivery take for customers in RJ in 2018-Q2?
questions.sql:
SELECT avg(days_to_deliver) AS avg_days_to_deliver
FROM order_delivery
WHERE customer_state = ?
  AND purchase_quarter = ?
LIMIT 100

questions.interpretation: What share of order lines did sellers hand to the carrier after their shipping deadline in 2018?
questions.sql:
SELECT avg(CAST(seller_shipped_late AS INTEGER)) AS seller_late_shipping_rate
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE purchase_quarter IN (?, ?, ?, ?)
LIMIT 100

questions.interpretation: Which 5 product categories had the highest late delivery rate in 2018, among categories with at least 500 orders?
questions.sql:
SELECT category AS category,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND is_late) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered), 0) AS late_delivery_rate
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE purchase_quarter IN (?, ?, ?, ?)
GROUP BY category
HAVING count(DISTINCT order_id) >= 500
ORDER BY late_delivery_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

questions.interpretation: Calculate the average review score for orders that were delivered late versus those delivered on time
questions.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN od.is_late THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_status,
       AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM reviews r
JOIN order_delivery od ON r.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE od.is_delivered = TRUE
GROUP BY delivery_status

questions.interpretation: What percentage of orders purchased in 2017 were canceled?
questions.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS canceled_percentage FROM order_delivery WHERE purchase_date >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND purchase_date < DATE '2018-01-01'

questions.interpretation: Count of delivered orders that had items from more than one seller
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_multi_seller_orders FROM order_delivery WHERE is_delivered = TRUE AND seller_count > 1

questions.interpretation: What was the average freight value per order for customers in SP and in RJ?
questions.sql:
SELECT customer_state AS state,
       AVG(order_freight) AS avg_freight_per_order
FROM (
    SELECT order_id,
           customer_state,
           SUM(freight_value) AS order_freight
    FROM orders_enriched
    WHERE customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
    GROUP BY order_id, customer_state
) sub
GROUP BY customer_state

questions.interpretation: Average promised delivery days for the quarters 2018-Q2 and 2018-Q3
questions.sql:
SELECT purchase_quarter AS quarter,
       avg(promised_days) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered) AS avg_promised_days
FROM order_delivery
WHERE purchase_quarter IN (?, ?)
GROUP BY purchase_quarter
ORDER BY purchase_quarter
LIMIT 100

questions.interpretation: Which carrier delivered the most late orders?
What was the on-time delivery rate in December 2018?
What was the profit margin by product category?
Why did on-time delivery drop in São Paulo in Q3 2018?
questions.sql:
-- contributions by category
SELECT CAST(purchase_quarter AS VARCHAR) AS period,
       COALESCE(CAST(category AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') AS segment,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND NOT is_late) AS num,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered) AS den
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE CAST(purchase_quarter AS VARCHAR) IN (?, ?)
  AND customer_state = ?
GROUP BY ALL

-- contributions by seller_state
SELECT CAST(purchase_quarter AS VARCHAR) AS period,
       COALESCE(CAST(seller_state AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') AS segment,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND NOT is_late) AS num,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered) AS den
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE CAST(purchase_quarter AS VARCHAR) IN (?, ?)
  AND customer_state = ?
GROUP BY ALL

-- contributions by seller
SELECT CAST(purchase_quarter AS VARCHAR) AS period,
       COALESCE(CAST(seller_id AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') AS segment,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered AND NOT is_late) AS num,
       count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered) AS den
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE CAST(purchase_quarter AS VARCHAR) IN (?, ?)
  AND customer_state = ?
GROUP BY ALL

questions.interpretation: Count of delivered orders to customers in the city "sao paulo" during 2018
questions.sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE is_delivered) AS delivered_orders
FROM orders_enriched
WHERE customer_city = ?
  AND purchase_month BETWEEN ? AND ?
LIMIT 100
